about: Where an agent session works, as the model is told it and as its tools read a path (context.md §11, spec 3.2.0). `op: env` — `root` is the project root and `started` the directory the session was started in (both absolute); the answer is the environment block's lines about them, in order, from loop.json context.env — none naming an absolute path. `op: resolve` — `path` as a tool call gives it; the answer is the absolute path it means: relative paths against the project root, whatever `started` is, `.` and `..` by their text (filesystem.md, Paths); an absolute path as it is. LLeMbas: not run — a chat's paths are the server's tree's; CLI: prompt/assemble.ts, tool/tool.ts.

cases.about: Started at the root: the project's name and nothing else.
expect: Project: app (paths are relative to its root)

cases.about: Started below the root: that directory, relative to the root.
expect: Project: app (paths are relative to its root)
Started in: packages/web (relative to the project root)
Project: site (paths are relative to its root)

cases.about: A relative path is resolved against the project root.
…also when the session started below the root: one base for every relative path.
The directory the session started in is reached by its path from the root.
An absolute path is still accepted, as it is.
.. is resolved by its text (whether it may be reached is the permission rules' business).
./ and repeated slashes are resolved by their text.
